response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang background, but the role requires native-level Japanese, deep C programming for UNIX, Linux kernel source analysis, and embedded networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips) — none of which are evidenced. His C/C++ exposure is brief (a ~7-month stint at National Instruments a decade ago), and there is no indication of Japanese language ability, networking protocol work, or firmware development. The hard requirements make this a clear mismatch despite his overall seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, and systems
Some low-latency systems and performance work (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput services)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD) and community teaching involvement
concerns: No evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency, a hard requirement
Minimal C/UNIX experience and no Linux kernel modification or embedded firmware background
No networking security domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching, SNMP/NETCONF)

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded C / Linux kernel / networking security experience
